conviction_note: Findings sum +2.7 (customer documents point to Q3 at or above the top of the $700-750m guide and to a Q4 guide at or above the $815m consensus, on a stock already down 37% in 20 days), but this name has risen after none of its last 5 prints and sold an August 10% revenue beat and raise by 5.2%, so p_up is held at 55 and the scaled number is 0.10 x 12.5 = +1.25, about half the findings' sum.
bar: Q3 revenue $725.5-727.6m, EPS $0.91-0.94 non-GAAP. Two estimate sources agree (Zacks via Yahoo 2026-10-22: $725.5m / $0.91, https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/ultra-clean-report-q3-earnings-134800319.html; MarketBeat/TradingView: $727.55m / $0.938, https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:ced2bb72fc085:0-uctt-q3-26-earnings-revenue-estimate-is-727-55m-usd/). Both sit at the midpoint of the company guide of $700-750m and $0.83-1.03 (8-K 2026-08-03, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001275014/000162828026051853/q22026pressrelease.htm). Q4 2026 revenue consensus is $815.1m, from one source only (Benzinga, undated snippet), so the Q4 bar is soft.
positioning_check: Short interest 3.25m shares = 7.39% of float, days to cover 2.2, down 12.4% from 3.71m (settlement 2026-10-15, published 2026-10-26; https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/UCTT/short-interest/). Not crowded, and shorts were covering into the print. Skew +0.58 vol points, which the baseline calls balanced. Put/call OI 0.61. Event-implied move 12.31% (ATM IV 101%). Tape: -37.2% over 20 days, -64.6% from the 52-week high ($144.22 on 2026-06-30), -2.1% over 5 days, and up about 8% on the print day ($46.71 to $50.50). A 2x single-stock leveraged ETF on UCTT (UCTX) exists, which suggests retail is involved.

findings.finding: Lam Research, one of UCTT's top two customers (the top two together were 'high 50s' % of revenue on the Q2 call), reported September-quarter revenue of $8.22B, up 22% q/q and above its own $8.10B midpoint. UCTT's Q3 guide midpoint of $725m implies only +12.4% q/q from $644.9m, and consensus ($725.5-727.6m) sits exactly at that midpoint. So the largest customer's same-quarter growth points to UCTT revenue at or above the $750m top of the guide, about +3% versus the bar. This lands inside the guided range on a name that sells its beats.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-03): revenue $644.9m against a ~$585m consensus (+10%) with a raised guide. The stock closed +7% that session and was +6% after hours, but the baseline window (close to next close) was -5.19%. The last 5 prints went 0 up and 5 down (-5.2, -4.2, -0.6, -13.9, -28.2).
findings.why_not_priced: If the sell side had marked UCTT's Q3 to Lam's actual +22% q/q, consensus would have moved toward or above the $750m top of the guide. It is still at the $725-728m midpoint (Zacks Earnings ESP 0.00%, dated 2026-10-22, the day after Lam reported). Instead of rising after Lam's beat, the stock gapped down 10% on 2026-10-22 with the sector.
findings.independence: Applied Materials, the other top customer, guided Semiconductor Systems revenue for Aug-Oct to ~$7.9B against $7.04B the prior quarter (+12% q/q), a separate document (https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/applied-materials-q3-earnings-call-highlights). UCTT's own Q2 call said there were no delivery pushouts and that most critical components were secured early (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-ultra-clean-tops-q2-2026-estimates-shares-jump-93CH-4832415).

findings.finding: On its 2026-10-21 call, Lam said that some suppliers' growth in demand from Lam is 'rising even much faster than Lam itself is growing'. It is 'actively working with our suppliers to accelerate their capacity expansion plans'. December shipments held back by component and clean-room constraints 'we will ship in the March quarter'. It gave a preliminary 2027 WFE outlook of 'more than $200 billion', against the mid-$150B range for 2026. For UCTT's Q4 guide, which is new information in this release, this argues against reading Lam's modest December guide ($8.6B, +4.6% q/q, with China domestic 'significantly lower') straight across to UCTT's $815m Q4 consensus (+12% q/q). UCTT says it will have $3.5B of annualised capacity (~$875m a quarter) ready by year end.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance has moved this stock both ways. Feb 2025 -28.2% and Apr 2025 -13.9% came on guides below the street (the 2025 downturn and tariffs). Aug 2026 the guide was raised to $700-750m from a prior-quarter $565-605m and the stock still closed the window -5.2% after a +6% after-hours spike.
findings.why_not_priced: The market read Lam's call as a cap: SOX -6.7% on 2026-10-22, Lam -12%, UCTT gapped from $52.22 to $46.79. If the supplier-demand half of the call were priced, a capacity-adding supplier with pricing tailwinds would have held up better than the toolmaker, not fallen 10% with it and 37% over 20 days. Q4 consensus of $815m (one source) has not visibly been cut, which is the downside risk netted into this size.
findings.independence: TSMC (2026-10-15 6-K and call) said 'tool inflation is real'; broker estimates put its 2027 capex at $83-90B against $60-64B in 2026 (https://xenospectrum.com/en/tsmc-q3-2026-gross-margin-capex/). UBS (2026-10-05) met UCTT management before the quiet period and became 'incrementally more bullish' on WFE; management said 2027 capex stays at run rate plus $100m for capacity (https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/ubs-lowers-ultra-clean-stock-price-target-on-capacity-expansion-93CH-4932467). The Lam-side negative (December guide +4.6%, China domestic down) comes from the same document and is netted here rather than filed twice.

findings.finding: UCTT enters the print at $50.50: down 37.2% over 20 days and 64.6% from its 2026-06-30 high of $144.22, against a sell-side average target of $128 (6 buy, 1 hold, 1 sell). Short interest is only 7.4% of float and fell 12% into the 10-15 settlement. The October drawdown has a documented sector cause, not a company one: TSMC sell-the-news on 10-15, then Lam's supply comment on 10-22 (SOX -6.7%, worst day since June). TipRanks' 10-15 note says it was 'not a company-specific disappointment'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: All 5 prior windows were negative, but the August 2026 print came after a run to $144 (YTD +196% by September) and the stock went into it +7% on the day. This is the first print in the baseline entered after a deep drawdown.
findings.why_not_priced: This is partly priced by construction: the price already sits low. The unpriced part would be visible as rising short interest or a put-heavy skew if the market expected a company-specific miss. Short interest fell 12% and skew is +0.58 (balanced). So the drawdown is priced as sector beta rather than as an expected UCTT miss, and a guide at or above consensus has room to re-rate.
findings.independence: TipRanks 2026-10-15 (https://www.tipranks.com/news/catalyst/ultra-clean-plunges-as-chip-sell-off-hits-equipment) and Motley Fool 2026-10-25 (https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/25/chip-stocks-to-buy-after-their-worst-day-since-june/) both attribute the move to the sector. Short-interest data from https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/UCTT/short-interest/. Peer Ichor is down 27.4% since its own last report (Zacks, https://www.zacks.com/stock/news/2983882/why-is-ichor-holdings-ichr-down-274-since-last-earnings-report).

findings.finding: On 2026-08-14 UCTT filed a $400m at-the-market equity program (424B5 plus an 8-K item 1.01; agents UBS, Barclays, Craig-Hallum, Oppenheimer), about 10% of the market cap at the time. The Q3 release and 10-Q will show how much was sold, and at what price, during a quarter when the stock fell from ~$85 to ~$60. Asked what the money buys: management told UBS it is to hold capital for inventory and possibly speed up the capacity buildout. That is corroborated by $630m of inventory at Q2, the expansion to $3.5B capacity by year end, and Lam's own statement that it is pushing suppliers to add capacity. Answer: it funds visible demand, so the sign is roughly neutral, with EPS dilution as the small offset.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ATM filing itself cost -9% on 2026-08-14 (TIKR). It has not been disclosed at a print before.
findings.why_not_priced: The dilution fear is priced (-9% on the filing day, and named again on 2026-09-10). What is not known is the amount sold. Yahoo's 2026-10-26 market cap of $2.094B at $46.71 implies ~44.8m shares, which is not visibly above the pre-ATM count, so heavy use is not evident.
findings.independence: Use of proceeds from UBS 2026-10-05 (https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/ubs-lowers-ultra-clean-stock-price-target-on-capacity-expansion-93CH-4932467). The EDGAR filing index shows the 424B5 and the 8-K dated 2026-08-14 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001275014&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40).

findings.finding: Operating cash flow was negative for the second straight quarter in Q2 (-$41.1m after -$33.3m). Inventory was $629.9m and cash fell to $255.9m from $323.5m, against $599.4m of long-term debt. With Q3 revenue guided up another ~12% and Lam pushing suppliers to add capacity, a third negative OCF quarter is likely. That was the quality-of-beat issue the market sold in July and August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Seeking Alpha attributed a ~20% July 2026 drop partly to negative OCF from the inventory build, and the August beat closed -5.2%. The cash line has coincided with selling.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the negative OCF is public and named in the 2026-09-10 and 2026-10-15 notes. Only the size of the Q3 outflow is new. The ATM gives a funding cushion, so the risk is optics, not solvency.
findings.independence: Zacks preview 2026-10-22 flags 'higher working capital needs' (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/ultra-clean-report-q3-earnings-134800319.html). The inventory build is also what corroborates the ramp in finding 4, so this is the same fact read as a cost.

findings.finding: CFO Michael Keogh (formerly Ford Model e CFO) took office 2026-08-05, succeeding Sheri Savage, and this is his first full quarter to report and guide. The COO also changed in March 2026 and a new director was added on 2026-09-30. A new CFO's first full guide is a modest risk of conservative framing, for example on the 17% gross margin path and the $4B / 20% GM 2027 target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print with a first-quarter CFO in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since July, and nobody prices a guiding style ahead of time. Small by construction.

baseline_tension: The findings lean up, which agrees with the deeply negative run-up (the free control points up) and is neutral to the balanced skew. They cut against the name's own reaction history of 0 up in 5 and a sold beat-and-raise in August, which is why p_up is held at 55.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 and lesson 6 (a verified fact is not a reaction; the beat lands inside or at the top of the guided range): the Lam-implies-Q3-beat finding cut from +2.0 to +0.8 because this name sold its August 10% beat and raise; p_up already reflected it, no second cut.

Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0): the positioning finding cut from +1.5 to +1.0. It is kept because the drawdown has a documented sector cause and UCTT is not a microcap, but the bounce is still an inference.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the ATM moved from -0.5 to 0.0 once the use of proceeds (inventory and capacity) was found corroborated by inventory, the capacity plan and Lam's supplier comment.
Lesson 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the CFO finding moved from -0.3 to -0.2 and the OCF finding from -0.5 to -0.4, since the inventory build is also the ramp's corroboration.
Lesson 9 (segment net of the rest): finding 2 left at +1.5; it rests on Lam, and AMAT and the smaller customers point the same way, so no net-of-rest cut was needed.
p_up moved from 57 to 55, and the expected move from +1.75 to +1.25.
